report.incidentSummary: Beginning at 10:10 IST (04:40:00 UTC) on 2026-10-15, overall UPI autopay mandate setup success dropped from ~96.5% to ~94%. The degradation was strictly isolated to partner bank Sahyadri, whose mandate success rate dropped to 63-71%, caused by upstream timeouts where Sahyadri's mandate registration endpoint took longer than 8000ms. All other partner banks functioned normally. Internal deployments and scheduled payout batches during the period did not cause the failure.
report.rootCauseStatement: Partner bank Sahyadri's upstream mandate registration API endpoint degraded starting at 2026-10-15T04:40:00.011Z (10:10:00 IST), hitting bank-connector's 8000ms synchronous timeout limit and returning 504 Gateway Timeout errors. This led mandate-service to fail mandate setups with error code BANK_TIMEOUT specifically for Sahyadri bank users.

hypotheses.cause: Partner bank Sahyadri's mandate registration endpoint experienced severe latency and timed out at the 8000ms boundary, causing bank-connector to return 504 Gateway Timeout and mandate-service to fail mandate registrations with BANK_TIMEOUT.
hypotheses.rationale: Bank-connector logs show 392 errors exclusively for Sahyadri with 'POST /mandates -> 504 Gateway Timeout after 8000ms' starting at 04:40:00.011Z. Correspondingly, mandate-service logged 402 BANK_TIMEOUT errors all isolated to Sahyadri, while metrics for all other banks (gomti, indus_valley, kaveri, northstar) remained completely healthy.

hypotheses.cause: A regression in mandate-service v2.4.0 (deployed at 04:22:00 UTC / 09:52 IST) specifically broke mandate registration or polling for Sahyadri Bank accounts.
hypotheses.rationale: Mandate-service v2.4.0 was deployed at 04:22:00 UTC, but mandate-service error rates and Sahyadri success rates remained baseline for another 18 minutes until 04:40:00 UTC. Bank-connector logs show the timeouts occurred on the HTTP call to Sahyadri's upstream API, and all other partner banks running on v2.4.0 experienced normal operations.

facts.statement: mandate-service was deployed at 2026-10-15T04:22:00.000Z (09:52 IST) via CHG-48217 from version 2.3.0 to 2.4.0 with summary 'release: new mandate status polling'.
No deployments or config changes were made to bank-connector or payout-service during the incident window or since 2026-10-14T00:00:00.000Z.
At 2026-10-15T04:40:00.011Z (10:10 IST), bank-connector began logging 'POST /mandates -> 504 Gateway Timeout after 8000ms' against bank sahyadri, totaling 392 occurrences through 07:00:00Z.
bank-connector p95 latency for sahyadri jumped from ~1600ms to ~8000ms starting at 04:40:00Z, and timeout_count jumped from ~0 to 10-18 counts/min.
All other partner banks in bank-connector (gomti, indus_valley, kaveri, northstar) maintained normal error rates (<1.1%), p95 latency (~1600-2400ms), and near-zero timeouts.
mandate-service logged 402 errors with 'bank-connector returned BANK_TIMEOUT' between 04:40:02Z and 07:00:00Z, all strictly tagged with bank sahyadri.
mandate_success_rate for sahyadri dropped from ~96.5% to 62.59%-71.31% starting at 04:40:00Z, while success rates for other banks stayed steady between 95.5% and 97.1%.
mandate-service error rate stayed at baseline (~1.0%) between the 04:22:00Z deployment and 04:40:00Z, rising only after 04:40:00Z.
The 10:00 IST (04:30 UTC) payout batch executed until ~04:53 UTC without causing database lock contention (db_lock_wait_ms remained ~3.95ms) or active connection spikes (mean 173.8).

inferences.statement: The mandate-service v2.4.0 deployment at 04:22:00Z is not the root cause because errors were delayed by 18 minutes and were strictly bank-specific to Sahyadri.
The issue is an external degradation of Sahyadri Bank's mandate registration gateway rather than an internal platform failure or NPCI network outage.

assumptions.statement: Bank-connector's routing rules and per-bank HTTP client timeouts for Sahyadri have remained constant and uncorrupted in runtime memory.

timeline.event: mandate-service v2.4.0 deployed via CHG-48217 ('release: new mandate status polling'); baseline error rate and bank success rates remain normal.
Scheduled payout batch begins processing in payout-service without impacting database or connector health.
bank-connector logs the first 'POST /mandates -> 504 Gateway Timeout after 8000ms' against bank sahyadri; p95 latency spikes towards 8000ms.
mandate-service records first BANK_TIMEOUT error for bank sahyadri; mandate success rate for Sahyadri falls to 82% and then to ~63-71%.
payout batch finishes; Sahyadri mandate timeouts continue unabated.
Payments product manager files incident INC-2727 suspecting the recent mandate-service deployment.

confidence.rationale: High confidence supported by concordant metric and log evidence across bank-connector and mandate-service confirming timeouts are 100% isolated to Sahyadri Bank's endpoint at 8000ms.

gaps.description: Direct confirmation or status notification from partner bank Sahyadri regarding their API degradation was not retrieved.
gaps.impact: Minimal impact on diagnosis as telemetry from bank-connector unequivocally isolates the 504 Gateway Timeouts to Sahyadri's POST /mandates upstream endpoint.

recommendedActions.action: Escalate the incident to Sahyadri Bank's technical partner operations team reporting degraded responsiveness and 8000ms timeouts on their POST /mandates API.
recommendedActions.rationale: The failure originates upstream on Sahyadri Bank's e-mandate platform.
recommendedActions.verification: Confirm receipt of acknowledgment from Sahyadri Bank support and track Sahyadri p95 latency returning below 2000ms.

recommendedActions.action: Temporarily present an in-app banner or warning for users attempting to register SIP autopay using Sahyadri Bank accounts advising them of partner bank delays, or offer alternative payment/mandate methods.
recommendedActions.rationale: Prevents repetitive user frustration while Sahyadri Bank resolves their upstream platform latency.
recommendedActions.verification: Check customer support incoming ticket volumes for mandate setup failures on Sahyadri accounts.

recommendedActions.action: Implement circuit breaker or adaptive fallback mechanisms in bank-connector specifically per partner bank to fail fast or queue non-urgent mandate registration requests when upstream latency exceeds thresholds.
recommendedActions.rationale: Prevents threads and HTTP client connections from holding resources for 8000ms during upstream partner outages.
recommendedActions.verification: Verify circuit breaker telemetry trips during synthetic high latency simulations in staging.

incident.title: Autopay setup failing for some users
incident.summary: Some users cannot set up UPI autopay for SIPs since around 10:00 IST. Mandate success on the dashboard is ~94%, a bit below normal, so it is not a full outage. We released mandate-service at 09:52 IST.
symptoms: autopay mandate setup fails for some users
incident.userImpact: Affected users cannot start SIPs on autopay.

timeout_count for sahyadri surged from ~0 to 7.25 counts/min at 04:40:00Z and fluctuated between 10.13 and 18.44 counts/min through 07:00:00Z, whereas timeout counts for all other partner banks remained near zero (averaging < 0.15 counts/min).

bank_latency_p95_ms for sahyadri increased from baseline ~1600 ms to 4778 ms at 04:40:00Z and plateaued around 8000 ms (~7940 to 8106 ms) for the rest of the window, whereas all other banks remained normal (p95 between ~1640 ms and ~2494 ms).

bank-connector logged 392 ERROR entries for bank sahyadri between 04:40:00Z and 07:00:00Z (compared to 4 total errors across all other banks), all consisting of 'POST /mandates -> 504 Gateway Timeout after 8000ms'.

The degradation is strictly isolated to partner bank sahyadri's mandate registration endpoint hitting an 8000ms timeout; there is no general degradation across other partner bank APIs or bank-connector.

# Investigation report: Autopay setup failing for some users

**Outcome:** conclusive · **Stop reason:** critic_accepted · **Confidence:** 0.92 · **Written by:** reporting agent

## Summary
Beginning at 10:10 IST (04:40:00 UTC) on 2026-10-15, overall UPI autopay mandate setup success dropped from ~96.5% to ~94%. The degradation was strictly isolated to partner bank Sahyadri, whose mandate success rate dropped to 63-71%, caused by upstream timeouts where Sahyadri's mandate registration endpoint took longer than 8000ms. All other partner banks functioned normally. Internal deployments and scheduled payout batches during the period did not cause the failure.

**Root cause:** Partner bank Sahyadri's upstream mandate registration API endpoint degraded starting at 2026-10-15T04:40:00.011Z (10:10:00 IST), hitting bank-connector's 8000ms synchronous timeout limit and returning 504 Gateway Timeout errors. This led mandate-service to fail mandate setups with error code BANK_TIMEOUT specifically for Sahyadri bank users.

## Hypotheses
